title: Context Is the First Thing a Meme Consumes — Exhibition Poster
image_status: pending: mockup shared in chat, not yet attached as a file for the repo
short_description: A field note from the Museum, printed before the context disappeared.
alt_text: Bone-white exhibition poster on a black gallery wall reading Context Is the First Thing a Meme Consumes. in tall black type with a small acid-green skull.
description: The Museum's working thesis, set as a limited-edition exhibition poster: "Context is the first thing a meme consumes." The stark condensed type and faint compression traces turn a research proposition into a visual warning about what gets lost when an idea becomes easy to repeat.
features: Carbon-black typography with an acid-green specimen mark
